entities.label: Earthquake event
entities.description: The global plate. Values here are the scenario a fixed-scenario function reads; a ShakeMap assembly needs none of them.

key_destination.description: A key destination (e.g. an airport or hospital). System functions use these as destinations, and the other nodes as origins.

avg_speed_kph.description: Average travel speed on this edge; travel time is length_km / avg_speed_kph.

entities.label: Bridge

edge.description: The edge this bridge carries. An edge with several bridges is open only if all are usable.

hazus_class.description: HWB1 ... HWB28; selects the fragility parameter set.

vs30.description: Time-averaged shear-wave velocity of the top 30 m at the bridge. Give it where known; python -m src vs30 fills the rest from the USGS Global Vs30 Mosaic.

vs30_source.description: Where vs30 came from: absent or 'user' for a supplied value, usgs-global-vs30-mosaic for the proxy.

entities.description: A bridge, where it is and what kind it is. Its location is what every hazard function reads, so ground motion is one node per bridge.

entities.label: System event
entities.description: What counts as the network surviving, for the system function to judge. One per network for now. Its destinations are the nodes marked key_destination; its origins are the nodes the assembly binds the system function to.

analysis.description: The system function that judges this event; the assembly must bind that one.

target_add_h.description: Extra time allowed over the intact network's travel time to the nearest key destination, in hours.
